name: Veg Makhanwala
steps: Cut carrots, beans and cauliflower into small pieces. Steam them with peas until just tender, keeping their colour and shape.
Simmer chopped tomatoes, cashews, ginger, garlic and water for 12 minutes. Cool slightly, blend smooth and strain if needed.
Melt butter, add the puree, Kashmiri chilli, salt and sugar. Simmer 10 minutes, stirring so the thick sauce does not catch.
Fold in vegetables, cream, garam masala and crushed fenugreek. Heat gently for 5 minutes until coated and hot throughout.
tips: Do not overcook the steamed vegetables; they finish cooking in the sauce.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
